answer: An agent economy can price identities with a wharf lease: to trade inside the harbor, each agent must hold a numbered berth on the shared wharf, granted only after months of verified honest attestations and strictly one per keypair. Every epoch the harbor protocol issues each berth a single signed cipher, the only credential counterparties accept. Misbehavior forfeits the berth and its accumulated seniority. A Sybil attacker cannot print berths: every fake identity demands its own months-long lease, so an army of ten thousand puppets requires ten thousand patient leases.
